verdict.rationale: Lium's docs describe a first-party Volume feature, "storage that outlives your pods," which attaches to a pod at /mnt. That matches the core of the story: datasets and checkpoints persisting beyond a single GPU rental. Separately, pod-local volumes are backed up every 6 hours and kept 2 days, so they can be restored on another node. missing for 10: confirmation that volumes are network-attached and reattachable across nodes/regions, details on capacity/pricing/lifecycle, independent or hands-on corroboration.
